comment: Index affricate → obstruent with delayed release (ASCA has no affricate grouping)
Index back vowel; V host avoids matching velar/uvular consonants
Index front vowel; V host avoids matching palatal consonants
Index laryngeal ≈ glottals (h ɦ ʔ); pharyngeals need cluster override
Index approximant ≈ liquids + glides; avoids bare [+approximant] matching vowels
Index velar consonant (matches crate TODO K matrix with C host)
Index palatovelar approx; overlaps palatals — medium fidelity
Index uvular OR click; dual meaning — cluster disambiguation often required
Index resonant/sonorant ≈ ASCA S ∪ G (not ASCA S alone)
Index plosive ↔ ASCA plosive grouping P
Index syllable ≈ ASCA whole-syllable % (Index % boundary → ASCA $ separately)
Index continuant; includes vowels — use {F L G} or O:[+cont] in clusters if too broad
